fidelityReview.scope: Historic birthplace at Bonngasse 20 and its rear courtyard massing; do not merge the neighboring research-center buildings into the birthplace.
fidelityReview.notes: Exact Emil Koch photographs, Wien Museum inventories 58411/1 and 58411/2 (circa 1890), explicitly released CC0 for the offered object images, were individually inspected at the original 3500×4230 pixels. Street view confirms paired window groups, three storeys, carved portal and twin curved dormers. Garden view confirms the attached lower birthplace wing, hipped two-pitch mansard, end-wall windows and end dormer, courtyard openings and paving. Official Beethoven-Haus building history independently confirms the surviving birthplace/front-house identity and courtyard arrangement. Corrected the garden roof and end elevation rather than preserving the former generic gable. Full Bonngasse20 scope retained; Bonngasse18, research/concert buildings, interiors, sculpture and people excluded. Paint colours, dimensions, hidden party walls, roof joins, small ornament and obscured openings remain bounded medium-fi estimates; these monochrome photos do not establish present paint colours. No photograph pixels embedded. Native mapped footprint, independent terrain and placement unchanged.
